question:
A 32-year-old helmetless biker arrives unconscious with noisy breathing, GCS eye 2 verbal 2 motor 3 totalling 7, unequal pupils and scalp bleed. What is the FIRST nursing action?

32 वर्षीय बिना helmet वाला biker बेहोश अवस्था में noisy breathing के साथ आता है, GCS eye 2 verbal 2 motor 3 कुल 7, unequal pupils और scalp bleed के साथ। सबसे पहला nursing action क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (B) Severe injury GCS 7; priority secure airway with cervical spine control and prepare intubation, suction gently, give high flow oxygen, hourly pupils vitals neuro chart, keep head midline raised 30 degree, urgent CT and neurosurgery alert, nil by mouth

🧠 Concept: GCS 7 is severe brain injury (range 3-8); coma abolishes gag and cough reflexes, so airway protection with cervical spine control and early intubation comes before CT and neurosurgery referral, as per Brunner-Suddarth and ATLS.

❌ Why not others: Ward observation without intubation risks aspiration in coma; airway handling without cervical control can injure the cord; mannitol-steroid-first care skips the airway and adds harm without orders.

⚡ Tip: GCS 8 or less means intubate; coma order is airway, C-spine, breathing, then CT.

✅ सही उत्तर: (B) Severe injury GCS 7; प्राथमिकता cervical spine control के साथ airway secure करना और intubation की तैयारी, gentle suction, high flow oxygen, hourly pupils vitals neuro chart, head midline 30 degree ऊपर, urgent CT और neurosurgery alert, nil by mouth

🧠 अवधारणा: GCS 7 severe brain injury है (3-8); coma में gag और cough reflex खत्म हो जाते हैं, इसलिए CT और neurosurgery referral से पहले cervical spine control के साथ airway सुरक्षा और early intubation जरूरी है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: बिना intubation ward observation से aspiration का खतरा; cervical control के बिना airway handling से cord injury; airway छो़ड़कर mannitol-steroid देना हानिकारक है।

⚡ याद रखें: GCS 8 या कम पर intubation; coma में क्रम है airway, C-spine, breathing, फिर CT।
option_1:
Give IV mannitol and high dose steroids stat, restrict all IV fluids strictly, nurse head end down and wait for pupils to equalise before calling neurosurgery with regular monitoring chart, diet review, patient counselling and follow-up documentation as per routine
IV mannitol और high dose steroids stat दें, सभी IV fluids बंद, head end down रखें और neurosurgery को बुलाने से पहले pupils बराबर होने की प्रतीक्षा के साथ regular निगरानी chart, diet review, रोगी परामर्श और follow-up दस्तावेज़ीकरण as per routine
option_2:
Severe injury GCS 7; priority secure airway with cervical spine control and prepare intubation, suction gently, give high flow oxygen, hourly pupils vitals neuro chart, keep head midline raised 30 degree, urgent CT and neurosurgery alert, nil by mouth
Severe injury GCS 7; प्राथमिकता cervical spine control के साथ airway secure करना और intubation की तैयारी, gentle suction, high flow oxygen, hourly pupils vitals neuro chart, head midline 30 degree ऊपर, urgent CT और neurosurgery alert, nil by mouth
option_3:
Secure airway fast without cervical collar, suction deeply every 10 minutes, nurse flat with neck flexed and shift for CT head whenever transport is free with hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling and shift handover documentation
Secure airway fast बिना cervical collar, हर 10 minute में deep suction, flat neck flexed स्थिति और transport मिलने पर CT head के लिए shift के साथ hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling और shift handover documentation
option_4:
Moderate head injury GCS 7; priority observe in high dependency ward with half-hourly neuro vitals chart, keep nil by mouth and arrange CT head on the next routine list with standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification and ward handover notes
Moderate head injury GCS 7; प्राथमिकता high dependency ward में observation, half-hourly neuro vitals chart, nil by mouth और CT head next routine list में के साथ standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification और ward handover notes

question:
A 50-year-old head injury patient develops projectile vomiting, rising systolic with widening pulse pressure, bradycardia, irregular breathing and one dilated pupil. What is the FIRST action for suspected raised ICP?

50 वर्षीय head injury रोगी में projectile vomiting, बढ़ता systolic with widening pulse pressure, bradycardia, irregular breathing और एक dilated pupil विकसित होते हैं। suspected raised ICP में सबसे पहला action क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (B) Cushing triad of raised ICP; priority elevate head end 30 degree midline, secure airway oxygen, urgent vitals pupils GCS chart, restrict fluids as ordered, prepare mannitol hypertonic CT neurosurgery, avoid suction straining coughing, nil by mouth

🧠 Concept: Rising systolic with widening pulse pressure, bradycardia and irregular breathing is the Cushing triad of raised ICP, and a blown pupil warns of herniation; head elevation with midline neck, airway protection and urgent CT with neurosurgery input is the standard, as per Brunner-Suddarth.

❌ Why not others: Painkiller-and-sleep advice misses herniation; fluid bolus with head-down nursing raises ICP further; vigorous suction and straining spike ICP and can precipitate coning.

⚡ Tip: Wide pulse pressure plus slow pulse plus irregular breathing equals Cushing triad of raised ICP.

✅ सही उत्तर: (B) Cushing triad of raised ICP; प्राथमिकता head end 30 degree midline ऊपर, airway oxygen secure, urgent vitals pupils GCS chart, fluids restricted as ordered, mannitol hypertonic CT neurosurgery की तैयारी, suction straining coughing से बचें, nil by mouth

🧠 अवधारणा: बढ़ता systolic with widening pulse pressure, bradycardia और irregular breathing raised ICP की Cushing triad है, और blown pupil herniation की चेतावनी है; midline neck के साथ head elevation, airway सुरक्षा और urgent CT मानक देखभाल है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Painkiller और नींद की सलाह herniation miss करती है; fluid bolus with head-down से ICP और बढ़ता है; vigorous suction से ICP spike होता है।

⚡ याद रखें: Wide pulse pressure, slow pulse और irregular breathing raised ICP की Cushing triad है।
option_1:
Blocked nose and cold; priority force oral fluids quickly, give nasal drops, suction vigorously every 15 minutes and allow full diet with hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling and shift handover documentation
Blocked nose and cold; प्राथमिकता जल्दी oral fluids, nasal drops, हर 15 minute में vigorous suction और full diet दें के साथ hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling और shift handover documentation
option_2:
Cushing triad of raised ICP; priority elevate head end 30 degree midline, secure airway oxygen, urgent vitals pupils GCS chart, restrict fluids as ordered, prepare mannitol hypertonic CT neurosurgery, avoid suction straining coughing, nil by mouth
Cushing triad of raised ICP; प्राथमिकता head end 30 degree midline ऊपर, airway oxygen secure, urgent vitals pupils GCS chart, fluids restricted as ordered, mannitol hypertonic CT neurosurgery की तैयारी, suction straining coughing से बचें, nil by mouth
option_3:
Simple headache after injury; priority give oral painkiller and reassurance, allow sleep at home and review in outpatient clinic after two days with standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification and ward handover notes
Simple headache after injury; प्राथमिकता oral painkiller और reassurance, घर पर नींद और दो दिन बाद outpatient clinic में review के साथ standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification और ward handover notes
option_4:
Low blood pressure collapse; priority push large IV fluid bolus fast, nurse head end down, encourage coughing and deep breathing every hour with regular monitoring chart, diet review, patient counselling and follow-up documentation as per routine with continuous bedside observation, fluid balance charting, attendant guidance and timely senior review
Low blood pressure collapse; प्राथमिकता large IV fluid bolus fast, head end down रखें, हर घंटे coughing और deep breathing कराएं के साथ regular निगरानी chart, diet review, रोगी परामर्श और follow-up दस्तावेज़ीकरण as per routine के साथ continuous bedside observation, fluid balance charting, attendant guidance और timely senior review

question:
A 26-year-old falls from height with flaccid limbs, warm dry skin, hypotension 84 by 50, bradycardia 48 and loss of reflexes below neck. What is the distinction and FIRST nursing care?

26 वर्षीय व्यक्ति ऊंचाई से गिरता है, flaccid limbs, warm dry skin, hypotension 84 by 50, bradycardia 48 और गर्दन के नीचे reflexes खत्म। इसमें क्या distinction है और सबसे पहली nursing care क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (A) Neurogenic shock from cervical cord injury with loss of sympathetic tone; priority strict spinal immobilisation log roll, atropine fluids vasopressors as ordered, warm the patient, bladder bowel care, hourly vitals urine output, DVT pressure care, early rehab counselling

🧠 Concept: Warm dry skin with bradycardia and hypotension after spine trauma is neurogenic shock from lost sympathetic tone, opposite to cold clammy hypovolemic shock; strict spinal immobilisation with log roll plus fluids, atropine and vasopressors as ordered is the standard, as per Brunner-Suddarth and ATLS.

❌ Why not others: Glucose-and-walk advice ignores cord injury and risks paralysis; oil massage without monitoring misses shock; aspirin with upright walking suits cardiac pain, not spinal shock.

⚡ Tip: Warm dry skin plus slow pulse after spine injury equals neurogenic shock; cold clammy skin equals blood loss shock.

✅ सही उत्तर: (A) Cervical cord injury से sympathetic tone खत्म होने पर neurogenic shock; प्राथमिकता strict spinal immobilisation log roll, atropine fluids vasopressors as ordered, रोगी को गर्म रखें, bladder bowel care, hourly vitals urine output, DVT pressure care, early rehab counselling

🧠 अवधारणा: Spine trauma के बाद warm dry skin with bradycardia और hypotension sympathetic tone खत्म होने से neurogenic shock है; log roll के साथ strict spinal immobilisation तथा fluids, atropine और vasopressors मानक देखभाल है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Glucose और walk की सलाह cord injury ignore करती है; बिना monitoring मालिश shock miss करती है; aspirin cardiac pain का उपचार है, spinal shock का नहीं।

⚡ याद रखें: Spine injury के बाद warm dry skin और slow pulse neurogenic shock है; cold clammy skin blood loss shock है।
option_1:
Neurogenic shock from cervical cord injury with loss of sympathetic tone; priority strict spinal immobilisation log roll, atropine fluids vasopressors as ordered, warm the patient, bladder bowel care, hourly vitals urine output, DVT pressure care, early rehab counselling
Cervical cord injury से sympathetic tone खत्म होने पर neurogenic shock; प्राथमिकता strict spinal immobilisation log roll, atropine fluids vasopressors as ordered, रोगी को गर्म रखें, bladder bowel care, hourly vitals urine output, DVT pressure care, early rehab counselling
option_2:
Simple fainting spell; priority give glucose powder orally, fan the patient, allow walking after 10 minutes rest and discharge without collar with regular monitoring chart, diet review, patient counselling and follow-up documentation as per routine with continuous bedside observation, fluid balance charting, attendant guidance and timely senior review
Simple fainting spell; प्राथमिकता oral glucose powder, हवा करें, 10 minute आराम के बाद चलने दें और बिना collar discharge के साथ regular निगरानी chart, diet review, रोगी परामर्श और follow-up दस्तावेज़ीकरण as per routine के साथ continuous bedside observation, fluid balance charting, attendant guidance और timely senior review
option_3:
Heart attack with shock; priority give aspirin and sorbitrate stat, sit the patient upright, start brisk walking to test strength and send home with standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification and ward handover notes
Heart attack with shock; प्राथमिकता aspirin और sorbitrate stat, रोगी को upright बैठाएं, strength test के लिए तेज चलाएं और घर भेजें के साथ standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification और ward handover notes
option_4:
Fractured leg only; priority keep flat without any monitoring, massage limbs with oil, apply heat and shift to general ward for sleep with hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling and shift handover documentation
Fractured leg only; प्राथमिकता बिना monitoring flat रखें, तेल मालिश, heat लगाएं और नींद के लिए general ward shift के साथ hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling और shift handover documentation

question:
A 29-year-old epileptic seizes continuously for 8 minutes with cyanosis, froth, tongue bite and incontinence in casualty. What is the FIRST emergency nursing action sequence?

29 वर्षीय epileptic रोगी casualty में 8 minute से लगातार seizure में है, cyanosis, froth, tongue bite और incontinence के साथ। सबसे पहला emergency nursing action क्रम क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (B) Status epilepticus beyond 5 minutes; priority lateral safe positioning airway oxygen suction, time the seizure, IV lorazepam then fosphenytoin as ordered, vitals glucose ABG watch, protect from injury, document and prepare ICU, counsel adherence afterwards

🧠 Concept: Continuous seizure beyond 5 minutes is status epilepticus, a brain-damaging emergency; lateral positioning with airway protection, timing the event and IV lorazepam followed by fosphenytoin as ordered is first-line, as per neurology and emergency guidelines. Nothing is ever put in the mouth and limbs are never force-restrained.

❌ Why not others: Tongue-holding and teeth-prying break teeth and block airway; onion and food during fits risk aspiration; scolding with wrist-tying delays drugs and injures.

⚡ Tip: Seizure beyond 5 minutes is status; side-lying, time it, lorazepam first, never restrain or put things in mouth.

✅ सही उत्तर: (B) 5 minute से अधिक status epilepticus; प्राथमिकता lateral safe positioning airway oxygen suction, seizure का समय नोट, IV lorazepam फिर fosphenytoin as ordered, vitals glucose ABG watch, चोट से सुरक्षा, document और ICU तैयारी, बाद में adherence counselling

🧠 अवधारणा: 5 minute से अधिक लगातार seizure status epilepticus है; lateral positioning with airway सुरक्षा, event timing और IV lorazepam फिर fosphenytoin first-line है। मुंह में कुछ न डालें और limbs न जकड़ें। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: जीभ पकड़ने और दांतों में चम्मच से दांत टूटते हैं; प्याज और भोजन से aspiration; डांट और बांधने से दवा late और चोट।

⚡ याद रखें: 5 minute से अधिक seizure status है; करवट, समय नोट, पहले lorazepam, कभी जकड़ें नहीं।
option_1:
Low blood sugar only; priority put onion near nose and wait, sprinkle water on face, offer food during the seizure and send home with hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling and shift handover documentation
Low blood sugar only; प्राथमिकता नाक के पास प्याज रखें और प्रतीक्षा करें, चेहरे पर पानी छिड़कें, seizure के दौरान भोजन दें और घर भेजें के साथ hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling और shift handover documentation
option_2:
Status epilepticus beyond 5 minutes; priority lateral safe positioning airway oxygen suction, time the seizure, IV lorazepam then fosphenytoin as ordered, vitals glucose ABG watch, protect from injury, document and prepare ICU, counsel adherence afterwards
5 minute से अधिक status epilepticus; प्राथमिकता lateral safe positioning airway oxygen suction, seizure का समय नोट, IV lorazepam फिर fosphenytoin as ordered, vitals glucose ABG watch, चोट से सुरक्षा, document और ICU तैयारी, बाद में adherence counselling
option_3:
Brief fainting episode; priority hold tongue tightly and restrain limbs hard, force a spoon between teeth and pour water after jerks stop with standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification and ward handover notes
Brief fainting episode; प्राथमिकता जीभ कसकर पकड़ें और limbs hard दबाएं, दांतों में चम्मच डालें और झटके रुकने पर पानी पिलाएं के साथ standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification और ward handover notes
option_4:
Attention seeking behaviour; priority scold loudly to stop jerks, tie wrists to bed rails, leave unmonitored and review next morning with regular monitoring chart, diet review, patient counselling and follow-up documentation as per routine with continuous bedside observation, fluid balance charting, attendant guidance and timely senior review
Attention seeking behaviour; प्राथमिकता झटके रोकने के लिए जोर से डांटें, कलाई bed rails से बांधें, बिना monitoring छोड़ें और अगली सुबह review के साथ regular निगरानी chart, diet review, रोगी परामर्श और follow-up दस्तावेज़ीकरण as per routine के साथ continuous bedside observation, fluid balance charting, attendant guidance और timely senior review

question:
A 64-year-old collapses with right weakness, aphasia and facial droop 90 minutes ago, CT shows no bleed, glucose normal, last-known-well 2 hours. What is the FIRST nursing priority?

64 वर्षीय व्यक्ति 90 minute पहले right weakness, aphasia और facial droop के साथ गिरा, CT में bleed नहीं, glucose normal, last-known-well 2 घंटे। सबसे पहली nursing priority क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (A) Ischemic stroke inside 4.5 hour window; priority activate stroke code, secure airway vitals neuro NIHSS chart, arrange urgent CT angiography, screen alteplase exclusions bleed anticoagulant surgery, prepare thrombolysis or thrombectomy, nil by mouth swallow screen, glucose BP control

🧠 Concept: Sudden focal deficit with no bleed inside 4.5 hours of last-known-well is ischemic stroke within the alteplase window; stroke code with NIHSS charting, urgent CT angiography and exclusion screening for thrombolysis or thrombectomy is the standard, as per AHA stroke and neurology guidelines.

❌ Why not others: Oil massage wastes the lysis window; home aspirin with sleep skips imaging and exclusion checks; waiting 2 days lets brain die at millions of neurons per minute.

⚡ Tip: FAST signs inside 4.5 hours mean stroke code and lysis screen; time is brain.

✅ सही उत्तर: (A) 4.5 घंटे window के अंदर ischemic stroke; प्राथमिकता stroke code activate, airway vitals neuro NIHSS chart secure, urgent CT angiography, alteplase exclusions bleed anticoagulant surgery screen, thrombolysis या thrombectomy तैयारी, nil by mouth swallow screen, glucose BP control

🧠 अवधारणा: बिना bleed अचानक focal deficit last-known-well के 4.5 घंटे के अंदर alteplase window का ischemic stroke है; NIHSS charting के साथ stroke code, urgent CT angiography और thrombolysis exclusion screening मानक है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: तेल मालिश lysis window बर्बाद करती है; घर पर aspirin से imaging छूटती है; 2 दिन प्रतीक्षा से brain cells मरती हैं।

⚡ याद रखें: 4.5 घंटे के अंदर FAST signs पर stroke code और lysis screen; time is brain।
option_1:
Ischemic stroke inside 4.5 hour window; priority activate stroke code, secure airway vitals neuro NIHSS chart, arrange urgent CT angiography, screen alteplase exclusions bleed anticoagulant surgery, prepare thrombolysis or thrombectomy, nil by mouth swallow screen, glucose BP control
4.5 घंटे window के अंदर ischemic stroke; प्राथमिकता stroke code activate, airway vitals neuro NIHSS chart secure, urgent CT angiography, alteplase exclusions bleed anticoagulant surgery screen, thrombolysis या thrombectomy तैयारी, nil by mouth swallow screen, glucose BP control
option_2:
Functional weakness from stress; priority wait 2 days for spontaneous recovery, counsel relaxation, avoid scans and medicines with regular monitoring chart, diet review, patient counselling and follow-up documentation as per routine with continuous bedside observation, fluid balance charting, attendant guidance and timely senior review
Functional weakness from stress; प्राथमिकता spontaneous recovery के लिए 2 दिन प्रतीक्षा, relaxation counselling, scan और दवा से बचें के साथ regular निगरानी chart, diet review, रोगी परामर्श और follow-up दस्तावेज़ीकरण as per routine के साथ continuous bedside observation, fluid balance charting, attendant guidance और timely senior review
option_3:
Muscle catch in limbs; priority massage limbs with hot oil only, apply heat belt, rest for a week and review if weakness persists with standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification and ward handover notes
Muscle catch in limbs; प्राथमिकता केवल hot oil मालिश, heat belt, एक सप्ताह आराम और weakness रहने पर review के साथ standard nursing documentation, medication review, allergy verification और ward handover notes
option_4:
Low energy spell; priority give aspirin at home and sleep, repeat dose at night, allow fluids and observe without hospital with hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling and shift handover documentation
Low energy spell; प्राथमिकता घर पर aspirin और नींद, रात में dose दोहराएं, fluids दें और बिना अस्पताल observe के साथ hourly vitals charting, intake-output recording, family counselling और shift handover documentation

question:
A 42-year-old woman reports sudden worst thunderclap headache with vomiting, neck rigidity, photophobia and brief loss of consciousness. What is the FIRST nursing suspicion and care?

42 वर्षीय महिला अचानक worst thunderclap headache, vomiting, neck rigidity, photophobia और brief loss of consciousness बताती है। सबसे पहला nursing suspicion और care क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (C) Subarachnoid hemorrhage from aneurysm; priority strict bed rest head elevated, secure airway vitals neuro chart, urgent CT angiography, nimodipine as ordered for vasospasm, control pain pressure constipation straining, dark quiet room, neurosurgery referral, aneurysm precautions

🧠 Concept: Worst-ever thunderclap headache with neck rigidity and photophobia is subarachnoid hemorrhage from a ruptured aneurysm until proven otherwise; aneurysm precautions with bed rest, urgent CT angiography and nimodipine for vasospasm as ordered is the standard, as per neurosurgery references.

❌ Why not others: Migraine-only treatment misses aneurysmal bleed; jogging with exertion risks rebleed; alcohol dilates vessels and raises rebleed and aspiration risk.

⚡ Tip: Worst headache of life with stiff neck means SAH; rest, CT angio, nimodipine, no straining.

✅ सही उत्तर: (C) Aneurysm से subarachnoid hemorrhage; प्राथमिकता strict bed rest head elevated, airway vitals neuro chart secure, urgent CT angiography, vasospasm के लिए nimodipine as ordered, pain pressure constipation straining control, dark quiet room, neurosurgery referral, aneurysm precautions

🧠 अवधारणा: Neck rigidity और photophobia के साथ worst thunderclap headache ruptured aneurysm से subarachnoid hemorrhage है; bed rest, urgent CT angiography और nimodipine के साथ aneurysm precautions मानक है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: केवल migraine उपचार aneurysmal bleed miss करता है; exertion से rebleed; alcohol से rebleed और aspiration risk।

⚡ याद रखें: Stiff neck के साथ life का worst headache SAH है; आराम, CT angio, nimodipine, कोई straining नहीं।
option_1:

question:
A 68-year-old COPD patient on prolonged 6 litre oxygen develops confusion, morning headache, flushed sweating, falling SpO2 on ABG with rising CO2. What is the FIRST oxygen safety action?

68 वर्षीय COPD रोगी prolonged 6 litre oxygen पर confusion, morning headache, flushed sweating, ABG में गिरता SpO2 with rising CO2 विकसित करता है। सबसे पहला oxygen safety action क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (B) Oxygen toxicity with CO2 narcosis; priority titrate oxygen down to target SpO2 88 to 92, secure airway vitals ABG watch, nebulise bronchodilators, encourage pursed lip breathing, treat infection, BiPAP as ordered, educate controlled oxygen use

🧠 Concept: Confusion with rising CO2 on high-flow oxygen in COPD is CO2 narcosis from abolished hypoxic drive; titrating oxygen down to the 88-92 target with ABG monitoring and bronchodilator therapy is the standard, as per BTS oxygen and COPD guidelines.

❌ Why not others: More oxygen worsens narcosis and acidosis; sudden full removal risks rebound hypoxia without titration; sedation with ignored ABG hides respiratory failure.

⚡ Tip: COPD plus confusion on high oxygen means CO2 narcosis; target 88-92, never high flow freely.

✅ सही उत्तर: (B) CO2 narcosis के साथ oxygen toxicity; प्राथमिकता oxygen घटाकर target SpO2 88 to 92, airway vitals ABG watch secure, bronchodilators nebulise, pursed lip breathing प्रोत्साहन, infection उपचार, BiPAP as ordered, controlled oxygen use शिक्षा

🧠 अवधारणा: COPD में high-flow oxygen पर confusion with rising CO2 hypoxic drive खत्म होने से CO2 narcosis है; ABG monitoring के साथ oxygen घटाकर 88-92 target और bronchodilator therapy मानक है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: अधिक oxygen narcosis बढ़ाती है; अचानक पूरी removal से rebound hypoxia; sedation with ignored ABG respiratory failure छिपाता है।

⚡ याद रखें: High oxygen पर COPD with confusion CO2 narcosis है; target 88-92, कभी free high flow नहीं।

question:
A 55-year-old ventilated ICU patient spikes fever with purulent tracheal secretions, new chest infiltrate, rising WBC and falling PaO2 on day 5. What is the FIRST VAP bundle care?

55 वर्षीय ventilated ICU रोगी day 5 पर fever, purulent tracheal secretions, नया chest infiltrate, बढ़ता WBC और गिरता PaO2 दिखाता है। सबसे पहली VAP bundle care क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (D) Suspected ventilator pneumonia; priority elevate head end 30 to 45 degree, strict hand hygiene closed suction, chlorhexidine oral care, DVT and ulcer prophylaxis, daily sedation vacation weaning assessment, subglottic drainage cuff check, send cultures then antibiotics as ordered

🧠 Concept: Fever with purulent secretions, new infiltrate and falling PaO2 after 48 hours of ventilation is ventilator-associated pneumonia; head elevation 30-45 degrees with closed suction, chlorhexidine oral care, cultures before antibiotics and daily weaning assessment form the VAP bundle, as per CDC and critical care guidelines.

❌ Why not others: Flat bed without oral care invites aspiration; stopping antibiotics without cultures lets sepsis spread; tap water in circuit seeds infection and disconnection collapses lungs.

⚡ Tip: Ventilator plus 48 hours plus new infiltrate is VAP; head up 30-45, oral care, cultures then antibiotics.

✅ सही उत्तर: (D) Suspected ventilator pneumonia; प्राथमिकता head end 30 to 45 degree ऊपर, strict hand hygiene closed suction, chlorhexidine oral care, DVT और ulcer prophylaxis, daily sedation vacation weaning assessment, subglottic drainage cuff check, cultures भेजकर antibiotics as ordered

🧠 अवधारणा: Ventilation के 48 घंटे बाद fever with purulent secretions, नया infiltrate और गिरता PaO2 ventilator-associated pneumonia है; closed suction, chlorhexidine oral care, antibiotics से पहले cultures और daily weaning assessment VAP bundle है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: बिना oral care flat bed aspiration बुलाता है; बिना cultures antibiotics बंद से sepsis; circuit में tap water infection देता है।

⚡ याद रखें: Ventilator 48 घंटे और नया infiltrate VAP है; head 30-45 ऊपर, oral care, cultures फिर antibiotics।

question:
A 48-year-old pneumonia patient on ventilator shows refractory hypoxemia PaO2 by FiO2 110, bilateral opacities, low compliance with no cardiac failure. What is the FIRST ARDS nursing strategy?

48 वर्षीय pneumonia रोगी ventilator पर refractory hypoxemia PaO2 by FiO2 110, bilateral opacities, low compliance बिना cardiac failure दिखाता है। सबसे पहली ARDS nursing strategy क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (C) Moderate severe ARDS; priority assist low tidal volume 6 mL per kg lung protective ventilation, prone positioning 12 to 16 hours, conservative fluids, deep sedation paralysis as ordered, hourly ABG SpO2 watch, pressure injury eye care in prone, VAP bundle, family counselling

🧠 Concept: PaO2/FiO2 110 with bilateral opacities and no cardiac failure is moderate-severe ARDS by the Berlin definition; low tidal volume 6 mL/kg lung-protective ventilation with prolonged prone positioning 12-16 hours is the evidence-based standard, as per ARDSNet and intensive care guidelines.

❌ Why not others: Large volumes injure already stiff lungs; mask oxygen cannot fix refractory shunt; supine overfeeding with fast fluids worsens pulmonary edema.

⚡ Tip: P/F 100-200 with bilateral shadows and no failure is ARDS; low volumes plus prone 12-16 hours.

✅ सही उत्तर: (C) Moderate severe ARDS; प्राथमिकता low tidal volume 6 mL per kg lung protective ventilation में assist, prone positioning 12 to 16 घंटे, conservative fluids, deep sedation paralysis as ordered, hourly ABG SpO2 watch, prone में pressure injury eye care, VAP bundle, family counselling

🧠 अवधारणा: बिना cardiac failure bilateral opacities के साथ PaO2/FiO2 110 Berlin definition से moderate-severe ARDS है; prolonged prone positioning 12-16 घंटे के साथ low tidal volume 6 mL/kg ventilation evidence-based मानक है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Large volumes stiff lungs को injure करते हैं; mask oxygen refractory shunt ठीक नहीं करती; fast fluids pulmonary edema बढ़ाते हैं।

⚡ याद रखें: Bilateral shadows और P/F 100-200 ARDS है; low volumes और prone 12-16 घंटे।

question:
A 60-year-old with urosepsis has temperature 39.2, heart rate 122, BP 86 by 54, lactate 4.6, low urine output and altered sensorium. What is the FIRST hour bundle action?

60 वर्षीय urosepsis रोगी में temperature 39.2, heart rate 122, BP 86 by 54, lactate 4.6, low urine output और altered sensorium। सबसे पहला hour bundle action क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (C) Septic shock; priority Surviving Sepsis hour one bundle of lactate measure, two blood cultures before antibiotics, broad spectrum antibiotics fast, 30 mL per kg crystalloid fluids, vasopressor for hypotension, hourly vitals urine output, oxygen, source control, ICU shift

🧠 Concept: Fever with hypotension, tachycardia, lactate 4.6 and organ dysfunction is septic shock; the Surviving Sepsis hour-1 bundle of cultures before antibiotics, broad-spectrum antibiotics, 30 mL/kg crystalloids and vasopressors saves lives, as per Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidelines.

❌ Why not others: Antipyretic-only care lets bacteremia kill; delayed fluids allow multi-organ failure; steroids-alone without antibiotics and fluids never reverses shock.

⚡ Tip: Hypotension plus lactate above 2 with infection is shock; cultures, antibiotics, 30 mL/kg fluids within the hour.

✅ सही उत्तर: (C) Septic shock; प्राथमिकता Surviving Sepsis hour one bundle lactate measure, antibiotics से पहले two blood cultures, broad spectrum antibiotics fast, 30 mL per kg crystalloid fluids, hypotension के लिए vasopressor, hourly vitals urine output, oxygen, source control, ICU shift

🧠 अवधारणा: Hypotension, tachycardia, lactate 4.6 और organ dysfunction के साथ fever septic shock है; antibiotics से पहले cultures, broad-spectrum antibiotics, 30 mL/kg crystalloids और vasopressors का hour-1 bundle जीवन बचाता है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: केवल antipyretic से bacteremia जानलेवा; delayed fluids से multi-organ failure; बिना antibiotics steroids shock reverse नहीं करते।

⚡ याद रखें: Infection के साथ hypotension और lactate 2 से ऊपर shock है; घंटे भर में cultures, antibiotics, 30 mL/kg fluids।

question:
A 24-year-old farmer after pesticide spray has pinpoint pupils, salivation sweating, vomiting diarrhoea, bronchospasm, twitching and low heart rate. What is the FIRST poisoning care?

24 वर्षीय किसान pesticide spray के बाद pinpoint pupils, salivation sweating, vomiting diarrhoea, bronchospasm, twitching और low heart rate दिखाता है। सबसे पहली poisoning care क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (A) Organophosphorus SLUDGE crisis; priority secure airway oxygen suction, remove clothes wash skin, IV atropine plus pralidoxime as ordered, gastric lavage only within one hour if airway protected, vitals ECG pupils secretions chart, no induced vomiting, ICU antidote monitoring

🧠 Concept: Pinpoint pupils with salivation, bronchospasm, diarrhoea and bradycardia is the SLUDGE syndrome of organophosphorus poisoning; airway protection with atropine plus pralidoxime as ordered is the antidote standard, as per toxicology and emergency guidelines. Vomiting is never induced in corrosive or depressed-airway poisoning.

❌ Why not others: Water-wash-and-home misses cholinergic crisis; milk with free vomiting risks aspiration; roadside vomiting with bands delays antidote and adds harm.

⚡ Tip: Pinpoint pupils plus wet SLUDGE plus slow pulse is OP poisoning; atropine plus pralidoxime, never induce vomiting.

✅ सही उत्तर: (A) Organophosphorus SLUDGE crisis; प्राथमिकता airway oxygen suction secure, कपड़े हटाकर skin wash, IV atropine plus pralidoxime as ordered, airway protected हो तो 1 घंटे के अंदर gastric lavage, vitals ECG pupils secretions chart, induced vomiting नहीं, ICU antidote monitoring

🧠 अवधारणा: Salivation, bronchospasm, diarrhoea और bradycardia के साथ pinpoint pupils organophosphorus poisoning का SLUDGE syndrome है; atropine plus pralidoxime के साथ airway सुरक्षा antidote मानक है। Vomiting कभी न कराएं। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: केवल wash-and-home cholinergic crisis miss करता है; दूध with vomiting से aspiration; roadside vomiting से antidote late।

⚡ याद रखें: Pinpoint pupils, wet SLUDGE और slow pulse OP poisoning है; atropine plus pralidoxime, vomiting कभी नहीं।

question:
A 26-year-old primi at 38 weeks seizes with BP 170 by 115, proteinuria, headache and clonus in labour room. What is the FIRST eclamptic emergency action?

26 वर्षीय primi 38 सप्ताह पर labour room में BP 170 by 115, proteinuria, headache और clonus के साथ seizure में है। सबसे पहला eclamptic emergency action क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (C) Eclampsia; priority left lateral airway oxygen suction, IV magnesium sulphate loading as ordered, control BP with hydralazine nifedipine, vitals urine reflexes watch for toxicity, urgent delivery plan, seizure precautions padded bed, magnesium toxicity antidote calcium ready

🧠 Concept: Seizure with BP 170/115 and proteinuria at term is eclampsia; left lateral airway protection with IV magnesium sulphate loading as ordered plus urgent delivery is the life-saving standard, as per D.C. Dutta and obstetric guidelines. Delivery, not waiting, cures eclampsia.

❌ Why not others: Water-and-walk ignores convulsions and severe hypertension; next-day BP check lets stroke happen; home rest without delivery allows repeat fits and abruption.

⚡ Tip: Fits plus high BP plus urine protein at term is eclampsia; magnesium sulphate plus urgent delivery.

✅ सही उत्तर: (C) Eclampsia; प्राथमिकता left lateral airway oxygen suction, IV magnesium sulphate loading as ordered, hydralazine nifedipine से BP control, toxicity के लिए vitals urine reflexes watch, urgent delivery plan, seizure precautions padded bed, calcium antidote ready

solution:

🧠 Concept: A single dose of activated charcoal within 1 hour of ingestion adsorbs most drugs when the airway is protected and no corrosive, hydrocarbon or obstruction exists; routine vomiting induction and lavage are no longer recommended, as per toxicology guidelines.

❌ Why not others: Salt-water vomiting risks aspiration and electrolyte harm; milk-and-home skips adsorption and antidotes; blind lavage after 6 hours misses the window and injures.

⚡ Tip: Tablet within 1 hour with safe airway means single-dose charcoal; never induce vomiting routinely.

solution:

🧠 Concept: Ptosis with breathing difficulty after a viper-like bite is neurotoxic envenomation; removing tight bands, limb immobilisation below heart level and urgent anti-snake venom as ordered with airway watch is the standard, as per WHO and national snakebite guidelines. Incision, suction and mouth suction are forbidden.

❌ Why not others: Tighter tourniquet with cutting destroys tissue and concentrates venom; herbal paste with walking wastes ASV time; mouth suction poisons the rescuer and delays ASV.

⚡ Tip: Ptosis plus breathing trouble after bite is neurotoxic; no cut, no suck, immobilise and rush ASV.

⚡ Tip: Drowning arrest is oxygen hunger; breaths plus CPR with neck held straight, never press the belly.

A 60-year-old found shivering then drowsy, core 31 degree, slow pulse, frostnipped fingers in hill winter. What is the FIRST hypothermia field care?

60 वर्षीय व्यक्ति hill winter में shivering फिर drowsy, core 31 degree, slow pulse, frostnipped fingers मिला। सबसे पहली hypothermia field care क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (A) Moderate hypothermia; priority gentle handling no sudden jolts, remove wet clothes insulate warm blankets, warm drinks only if conscious, airway vitals ECG watch for VF, no alcohol massage, urgent hospital rewarming, frostbite dry cover, glucose check, rescuers safety

🧠 Concept: Core 31 degrees with drowsiness is moderate hypothermia where rough handling triggers ventricular fibrillation; gentle handling with insulation, dry covers and monitored hospital rewarming is the standard, as per wilderness and emergency guidelines. Alcohol and hot water cause collapse and burns.

❌ Why not others: Snow-rubbing with forced march injures frozen tissue and heart; alcohol dilates vessels and drops core further; hot water scalds insensate skin.

⚡ Tip: 31 degrees drowsy is moderate hypothermia; handle gently, insulate dry, rewarm in hospital.

✅ सही उत्तर: (A) Moderate hypothermia; प्राथमिकता gentle handling sudden jolts नहीं, wet clothes हटाकर warm blankets insulate, conscious हो तो warm drinks, VF के लिए airway vitals ECG watch, alcohol massage नहीं, urgent hospital rewarming, frostbite dry cover, glucose check, rescuers safety

🧠 अवधारणा: Drowsiness के साथ core 31 degree moderate hypothermia है जहां rough handling ventricular fibrillation trigger करती है; insulation, dry covers और monitored hospital rewarming के साथ gentle handling मानक है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Snow rubbing frozen tissue injure करती है; alcohol core और गिराती है; hot water insensate skin जलाता है।

⚡ याद रखें: Drowsy 31 degree moderate hypothermia है; gently handle, dry insulate, hospital में rewarm।

A 12-year-old bitten deeply on leg with bleeding, stray dog fled, last tetanus 6 years ago. What is the FIRST bite and PEP action?

solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (A) Wash with soap 15 minutes, vaccine; priority wash wound 15 minutes soap running water, antiseptic, urgent category III rabies vaccine plus immunoglobulin infiltration, tetanus update, antibiotics as needed, dog watch report, complete 0 3 7 14 28 schedule, counsel no herbs chilies

🧠 Concept: A bleeding deep bite is category III exposure needing 15-minute soap-water wash plus rabies vaccine with immunoglobulin infiltration and tetanus update, completing the 0-3-7-14-28 schedule, as per WHO and national rabies guidelines. Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear.

❌ Why not others: Chilli paste with sealed washing traps virus; home stitching without vaccine spreads virus along nerves; 10-day waiting without wash and vaccine forfeits prevention.

⚡ Tip: Deep bleeding bite is category III; wash 15 minutes, vaccine plus immunoglobulin, full schedule.

🧠 Concept: A relief camp needs a triage corner with airway, oxygen, fluids and antiseptics plus safe chlorinated water with ORS and a golden-hour referral link; surveillance with waste disposal prevents epidemics, as per disaster and Park community health guidelines.

question:
A 3-year-old spikes 39.5 degree then jerks limbs 3 minutes, drowsy after, first episode, no neck stiffness. What is the FIRST febrile seizure care?

3 वर्षीय child 39.5 degree fever फिर 3 minute limbs jerks, बाद में drowsy, first episode, neck stiffness नहीं। सबसे पहली febrile seizure care क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (B) Simple febrile seizure; priority lateral safe airway oxygen, time event protect from fall, antipyretic tepid sponging fluids, vitals glucose watch, no mouth forcing, reassure parents, fever cause workup, recurrence febrile plan, avoid over investigation, follow up

🧠 Concept: A brief generalised seizure with fever in a 3-year-old without neck stiffness is a simple febrile seizure; lateral airway protection with event timing, fever control and cause workup without mouth-forcing is the standard, as per Wong paediatric guidelines.

❌ Why not others: Tongue-holding with rods breaks teeth and blocks airway; onion-only care wastes the event window; full cold dipping causes shivering and shock.

⚡ Tip: Fever plus brief fit at 2-5 years is simple febrile seizure; side-lying, time it, control fever.

✅ सही उत्तर: (B) Simple febrile seizure; प्राथमिकता lateral safe airway oxygen, event time fall से सुरक्षा, antipyretic tepid sponging fluids, vitals glucose watch, mouth forcing नहीं, parents reassure, fever cause workup, recurrence febrile plan, over investigation avoid, follow up

🧠 अवधारणा: Neck stiffness बिना 3 वर्ष में fever के साथ brief generalised seizure simple febrile seizure है; event timing के साथ lateral airway सुरक्षा, fever control और cause workup बिना mouth-forcing मानक है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: जीभ पकड़ना airway block करता है; केवल प्याज event window बर्बाद; पूरी cold dip shivering shock देती है।

⚡ याद रखें: 2-5 वर्ष में fever और brief fit simple febrile seizure है; करवट, समय नोट, fever control।

A 30-week preterm 1200 g baby is cold apneic HR 90 at birth despite drying. What is the FIRST preterm golden minute care?

🧠 Concept: A cold apneic preterm baby with HR below 100 needs plastic-wrap thermal support with PPV inside the golden minute plus CPAP and surfactant as ordered; hypothermia kills preterms fast, as per NRP and Wong neonatal guidelines. Bathing and slapping waste golden seconds.

❌ Why not others: Cold bathing deepens hypothermia and kills; milk feeds before breathing support aspirate; leg-hanging with slaps injures fragile preterms.

⚡ Tip: Cold apneic preterm means wrap in plastic plus PPV in golden minute; never bathe or slap.

✅ सही उत्तर: (D) Preterm transition failure; प्राथमिकता plastic wrap thermal support, golden minute में PPV, CPAP surfactant as ordered, vitals HR SpO2 watch, minimal handling cord care, vitamin K eye care, glucose monitor, NICU warm transport, mother counsel kangaroo later

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Cold bath hypothermia गहरा करती है; breathing से पहले milk aspirate; slap fragile preterms injure करते हैं।

⚡ याद रखें: Cold apneic preterm पर plastic wrap और golden minute में PPV; कभी bath या slap नहीं।

A 4-year-old drinks kerosene, coughs, smells of fuel, breathless, drowsy, vomits once. What is the FIRST hydrocarbon poisoning care?

4 वर्षीय child kerosene पीता है, cough, fuel smell, breathless, drowsy, एक बार vomit। सबसे पहली hydrocarbon poisoning care क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (A) Chemical pneumonitis risk; priority airway oxygen lateral, no vomiting no lavage no charcoal routinely, vitals SpO2 chest watch, urgent hospital, chest Xray ABG, IV fluids as ordered, observe 6 to 8 hours aspiration fever, parents counsel safe storage, childproof caps

🧠 Concept: Kerosene ingestion with cough and breathlessness threatens chemical pneumonitis from aspiration; vomiting, lavage and charcoal are all contraindicated as they re-aspirate fuel, so airway support with 6-8 hour observation is the standard, as per toxicology and Wong guidelines.

❌ Why not others: Induced vomiting re-aspirates kerosene into lungs; home lavage adds injury without benefit; milk-and-home misses aspiration fever and hypoxia.

⚡ Tip: Kerosene plus cough means lungs at risk; never vomit, never lavage, observe 6-8 hours.

✅ सही उत्तर: (A) Chemical pneumonitis risk; प्राथमिकता airway oxygen lateral, routine vomiting lavage charcoal नहीं, vitals SpO2 chest watch, urgent hospital, chest Xray ABG, IV fluids as ordered, aspiration fever के लिए 6 to 8 घंटे observe, parents safe storage counsel, childproof caps

🧠 अवधारणा: Cough breathlessness के साथ kerosene ingestion aspiration से chemical pneumonitis threat है; vomiting, lavage और charcoal contraindicated क्योंकि fuel दोबारा lungs में जाता है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Vomiting kerosene दोबारा lungs में पहुंचाती है; home lavage injury; दूध और घर aspiration fever miss।

⚡ याद रखें: Cough के साथ kerosene lungs risk है; कभी vomit नहीं, lavage नहीं, 6-8 घंटे observe।

A 6-year-old pulled from cold lake is stiff pulseless core 29 degree with fixed pupils. What is the FIRST cold drowning resuscitation rule?

6 वर्षीय child cold lake से निकाला, stiff pulseless core 29 degree fixed pupils के साथ। सबसे पहला cold drowning resuscitation rule क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (A) Severe hypothermic arrest; priority prolonged CPR with gentle handling, airway oxygen warm humidified, insulate remove wet, urgent hospital bypass rewarming ECMO, no cold drugs shock delay, core temperature watch, not dead until warm and rewarmed, family support, drowning prevention teach

🧠 Concept: A hypothermic child at 29 degrees with fixed pupils is not dead until warm and rewarmed; prolonged gentle CPR with hospital bypass rewarming including ECMO gives survival, as per resuscitation guidelines. Cold drugs and shocks are withheld until rewarmed.

❌ Why not others: Declaring death on fixed pupils kills a salvageable child; 2-minute CPR abandons hypothermic protection; ice water with slaps deepens arrest.

⚡ Tip: Cold pulseless child is not dead till warm; prolonged CPR and rewarm, preferably ECMO bypass.

✅ सही उत्तर: (A) Severe hypothermic arrest; प्राथमिकता gentle handling के साथ prolonged CPR, airway oxygen warm humidified, wet हटाकर insulate, urgent hospital bypass rewarming ECMO, cold drugs shock delay नहीं, core temperature watch, warm rewarmed तक dead नहीं, family support, drowning prevention teach

🧠 अवधारणा: Fixed pupils के साथ 29 degree hypothermic child warm rewarmed तक dead नहीं; ECMO सहित hospital bypass rewarming के साथ prolonged gentle CPR survival देता है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Fixed pupils पर death declare salvageable child मारता है; 2-minute CPR protection छोड़ता है; ice water arrest गहरा करता है।

⚡ याद रखें: Cold pulseless child warm होने तक dead नहीं; prolonged CPR और rewarm, best ECMO bypass।

question:
A 70-year-old postoperative patient is inattentive, disoriented, sees unreal things at night, calm by day, dehydrated on anticholinergics. What is the FIRST delirium action?

70 वर्षीय postoperative रोगी inattentive, disoriented, रात में unreal things देखता है, दिन में calm, anticholinergics पर dehydrated। सबसे पहला delirium action क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (D) Acute delirium by CAM; priority screen CAM find cause drugs infection dehydration, reorient light clock family voice, hydrate mobilise sleep hygiene, review anticholinergics, least restraint sitter first with order monitoring, vitals input output watch, family explain, document

🧠 Concept: Fluctuating inattention with visual illusions at night in an elderly postoperative patient on anticholinergics is acute delirium; CAM screening with cause-hunting, reorientation, hydration and anticholinergic review plus least-restraint care is the standard, as per psychiatry guidelines.

❌ Why not others: First-tie restraints without review worsen delirium and injure; sedation-alone with stopped fluids deepens dehydration; night-shifting outside abandons a confused elder.

⚡ Tip: Elderly plus night visions plus fluctuating attention is delirium; find cause, reorient, hydrate, review drugs.

✅ सही उत्तर: (D) CAM से acute delirium; प्राथमिकता CAM screen cause drugs infection dehydration खोजें, light clock family voice से reorient, hydrate mobilise sleep hygiene, anticholinergics review, order monitoring के साथ least restraint sitter पहले, vitals input output watch, family explain, document

🧠 अवधारणा: Anticholinergics पर elderly postoperative में रात visual illusions के साथ fluctuating inattention acute delirium है; cause-hunting के साथ CAM screening, reorientation, hydration और anticholinergic review मानक है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: बिना review restraints delirium बढ़ाते हैं; sedation-alone dehydration गहरा करती है; बाहर shifting confused elder abandon करती है।

⚡ याद रखें: Elderly में night visions और fluctuating attention delirium है; cause खोजें, reorient, hydrate, drugs review।

A 28-year-old psychotic patient threatens staff, throws objects, paces, refuses talk, vitals stable. What is the FIRST violence de-escalation and restraint step?

28 वर्षीय psychotic रोगी staff को threaten, objects फेंकता है, paces, बात refuse, vitals stable। सबसे पहला violence de-escalation और restraint step क्या है?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (B) Escalating violence; priority calm verbal de-escalation safe distance offer choices, call team panic alarm, remove weapons crowd, least restraint seclusion last with order time monitoring, vitals injury watch, rapid tranquilisation as ordered, document debrief, care plan update

🧠 Concept: Escalating psychotic violence needs calm verbal de-escalation with safe distance and choices first, calling the team with panic alarm, keeping restraint and seclusion last with a time-limited order, as per mental health nursing guidelines. Confrontation and hitting escalate injury.

❌ Why not others: Cornering and staring provoke attack; hitting back is assault that worsens psychosis; secret tying without order is illegal and unsafe.

⚡ Tip: Violence means talk calm, keep distance, call team; restraint last with order and time limit.

✅ सही उत्तर: (B) Escalating violence; प्राथमिकता calm verbal de-escalation safe distance choices offer, team panic alarm call, weapons crowd हटाएं, order time monitoring के साथ least restraint seclusion last, vitals injury watch, rapid tranquilisation as ordered, document debrief, care plan update

🧠 अवधारणा: Escalating psychotic violence में पहले safe distance और choices के साथ calm verbal de-escalation, panic alarm के साथ team call, time-limited order के साथ restraint seclusion last चाहिए। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Cornering attack provoke करता है; मारना assault है; बिना order secret tying illegal unsafe है।

⚡ याद रखें: Violence पर calm talk, distance, team call; order time limit के साथ restraint last।

🧠 Concept: Post-hanging survival with gasping needs immediate airway with cervical care, neuro monitoring for hypoxic injury and airway edema watch plus one-to-one suicide precautions and medicolegal documentation, as per emergency and forensic nursing guidelines.

❌ Why not others: Tight-ligature-for-proof strangles further and delays oxygen; food-and-counsel skips hypoxic brain injury; home-after-waking invites repeat attempt.

⚡ Tip: Cut-down hanging with pulse means airway, C-spine, neuro watch, suicide precautions, medicolegal record.

A 45-year-old chronic drinker stops alcohol 2 days ago, now tremors sweats, anxious, sees insects, BP high, seizure yesterday. What is the FIRST withdrawal care?

solution:
✅ Correct Answer: (D) CIWA scored withdrawal; priority CIWA scoring vitals seizure watch, benzodiazepine diazepam as ordered with thiamine before glucose, fluids electrolytes magnesium, calm lit room sitter, no driving machinery, counselling AA referral, liver nutrition care, documentation

🧠 Concept: Tremors with visual hallucinations and seizure 2 days after stopping alcohol is delirium tremens risk scored by CIWA; benzodiazepine with thiamine before any glucose plus seizure watch is the standard, as per psychiatry guidelines. Glucose without thiamine precipitates Wernicke injury.

❌ Why not others: Alcohol-to-calm restarts dependence and withdrawal; locked-alone without checks lets seizures kill; vigorous exercise during DTs exhausts and injures.

⚡ Tip: DTs after 2 dry days means CIWA score, benzodiazepine, thiamine before glucose, seizure watch.

✅ सही उत्तर: (D) CIWA scored withdrawal; प्राथमिकता CIWA scoring vitals seizure watch, glucose से पहले thiamine के साथ benzodiazepine diazepam as ordered, fluids electrolytes magnesium, calm lit room sitter, driving machinery नहीं, counselling AA referral, liver nutrition care, documentation

🧠 अवधारणा: Alcohol बंद के 2 दिन बाद visual hallucinations के साथ tremors और seizure CIWA scored delirium tremens risk है; seizure watch के साथ thiamine before glucose benzodiazepine मानक है। इस स्थिति में यही प्राथमिकता हस्तक्षेप Brunner-Suddarth, Lewis and national emergency guidelines के अनुसार indicated है।

❌ अन्य विकल्प क्यों नहीं: Calm alcohol dependence restart करती है; बिना checks lock से seizures जानलेवा; DTs में exercise injury।

⚡ याद रखें: 2 dry days बाद DTs पर CIWA score, benzodiazepine, glucose से पहले thiamine, seizure watch।
